description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class PartialThemeTest that tests the PartialTheme Data Transfer Object (DTO) in the CorporateBranding plugin. It includes setup code to initialize test data and a test method for creating a PartialTheme instance from a Theme entity and verifying its properties.

classes.name: PartialThemeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the creation of PartialTheme objects from Theme entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by loading a Theme fixture before each test.

methods.name: testCreateFromTheme
methods.description: Tests creating a PartialTheme instance from a Theme and asserts the expected id and name.
